te: Questions to agencies prepared, and a study visit to the western border in Ranong–Chumphon
se: The meeting noted a letter to the Chair of the committee concerning boundary marker 73 and the highest point of Ko Kut, an important marker of Thailand's boundary. It approved questions for the joint meeting with the committee on 23 January 2025, with the subcommittee's study report to be sent to agencies for their views, and approved the schedule of a study visit on western border security in Ranong and Chumphon Provinces on 24–25 January 2025, as well as a draft schedule for a visit to the eastern border
it: Letter concerning boundary marker 73 and the highest point of Ko Kut
Issues and questions for agencies at the joint meeting with the committee on 23 January 2025
Schedule of the study visit on western border security, Ranong and Chumphon Provinces
Draft schedule of the study visit on eastern border security

te: Draft report on Ko Kut approved, and a study visit to Trat prepared
se: The meeting approved the draft report on the study of overlapping maritime claims around Ko Kut, asking for the content to be completed, approved the schedule of a study visit to Trat Province, and approved inviting the agencies concerned to a joint meeting with the committee on 23 January 2025 on 2 issues: preparing oil and electricity supplies in the event of war, and overlapping maritime claims around Ko Kut
it: Draft report on the study of overlapping maritime claims around Ko Kut
Schedule of the study visit to Trat Province
Issues for the joint meeting with the committee: energy readiness in wartime, and Ko Kut

te: A moment of silence for fallen soldiers, and the 2026 action plan considered
se: The Chair asked the meeting to stand in silence in tribute to the soldiers who lost their lives on duty in the combat situation on the Thai–Cambodian border. The meeting then noted the schedule of the committee's study visits to the southern border provinces and Nakhon Phanom Province in January 2026, and considered a draft order setting up working groups, tasks for advisers, and the details of the action plan for fiscal year 2026, for the committee's working manual
it: A moment of silence in tribute to the soldiers who lost their lives in the combat situation on the Thai–Cambodian border
Schedule of study visits to the southern border provinces and Nakhon Phanom Province, January 2026
Draft order setting up working groups and tasks for advisers under the action plan for fiscal year 2026

te: Instructions from the seminar noted: a manual to be prepared and working groups set up
se: The meeting noted the outcome of the meeting of the Committee on Political Development and related matters on the death of a conscript at a military camp in Phitsanulok Province, which a representative of the committee attended, and noted the instructions given by the Chair of the committee at the seminar on 4 December 2025: preparing a working manual for fiscal year 2026, setting up the committee's working groups, and having subcommittees include advisers in working groups, to prepare the action plan for fiscal year 2026
it: Outcome of the meeting of the Committee on Political Development and related matters on the death of a conscript at a military camp in Phitsanulok Province
Instructions from the Chair of the committee at the workshop
Preparation of the subcommittee's action plan for fiscal year 2026

te: Lessons from the Hat Yai floods, and a vision prepared for the seminar
se: The meeting noted that the committee had assigned a representative to join a meeting of the Committee on Political Development, Public Participation, Human Rights, Rights, Liberties and Consumer Protection on the death of a conscript at a military camp in Phitsanulok Province. It discussed lessons learned from the floods in Hat Yai, where participants saw the need to improve warning and incident command systems and to make serious use of simulation and legally required drills, and prepared a vision for the committee's workshop "Review of Work in Fiscal Year 2025 and Preparation of the Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2026" (4 December 2025), such as making the armed forces structure leaner and more agile and developing personnel
it: Representative assigned to join the meeting of the Committee on Political Development and related matters on the death of a conscript at a military camp in Phitsanulok Province
Lessons learned from the floods in Hat Yai
Preparations for the committee's workshop

te: Issues on the draft military courts law and a work plan prepared for the committee's seminar
se: The meeting noted the invitation to the committee's workshop "Review of Work in Fiscal Year 2025 and Preparation of the Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2026" (4 December 2025) and the schedule of a joint meeting with the Office of the National Security Council, ISOC and the Ministry of Interior on approaches to managing migration at the national level on 24 November 2025. It then considered the key issues of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... prepared for giving academic views, asking for the wording to be tightened before submission to the committee, and considered the subcommittee's work plan from December 2025
it: Schedule of the workshop, and the joint meeting on national-level migration
Key issues of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... for giving academic views
The subcommittee's work plan for the seminar

te: More advisers proposed, and working groups set up to study the draft military courts law and personnel development
se: The meeting considered changes to and the appointment of additional advisers to the subcommittee, agreeing to propose them to the committee, and considered setting up a working group to prepare a study report on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and a working group to study approaches to developing armed forces personnel (in the case of conscripts)
it: Appointment of additional advisers to the subcommittee
Working group to prepare the study report on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. ....
Working group to study approaches to developing armed forces personnel: in the case of conscripts

te: Working group set up to study the draft military courts law, and a study visit to Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters prepared
se: The meeting considered progress in studying the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... (main draft) and the draft Act on Procedure for Corruption and Misconduct Cases (No. ..) B.E. ...., proposed by members of the House of Representatives, under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure B.E. 2568 (2025). It resolved to report progress to the committee, approved setting up a working group to prepare the report, and considered the schedule of a study visit and discussions with Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters
it: Progress in studying the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on Procedure for Corruption and Misconduct Cases (No. ..) B.E. ....
Working group set up to prepare the study report on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. ....
Schedule of the study visit and discussions with Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters

te: The Judge Advocate General's Department heard on the draft military courts law, and 3 study reports followed up
se: The meeting invited representatives of the Judge Advocate General's Department and experts to give information on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on Procedure for Corruption and Misconduct Cases (No. ..) B.E. ...., and followed up progress on 3 study reports: criteria for veterans' benefits, using reserve forces to support disaster relief, and approaches to developing armed forces personnel
it: The draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on Procedure for Corruption and Misconduct Cases (No. ..) B.E. ....
Study report: developing criteria for veterans' benefits
Study report: framework and direction for using reserve forces to support disaster relief
Study report: approaches to developing armed forces personnel

te: Help sought in finding training aids for the Army Non-Commissioned Officer School
se: The meeting noted from its study visit to the Army Non-Commissioned Officer School on 28 August 2025 that the school lacks modern training aids, and that the subcommittee has coordinated to find ways to help
it: The Army Non-Commissioned Officer School's need for modern training aids

te: Agencies' statements on border disputes noted
se: The meeting noted matters from the committee's meeting on 4 September 2025: the statements of facts from the Office of the National Security Council and the Anti-Money Laundering Office on their position and approach on disputes in Thailand's border areas, made in response to the committee's summons letters, and a legal opinion of the Secretariat of the Senate on a request to receive the subcommittee's meeting records
it: Statements of facts from the NSC and AMLO on disputes in border areas
Legal opinion on a request to receive meeting records

te: Study visits to the reserve forces school and the Army Non-Commissioned Officer School summarised
se: The meeting noted the summary of the subcommittee's study visits to the Infantry Center, the Reserve Affairs School, the Reserve Affairs Center and the Army Non-Commissioned Officer School, Prachuap Khiri Khan Province, in late August 2025, for submission to the committee, and noted the working groups' reports and the monitoring of developments in the South China Sea
it: Summary of the study visit to Prachuap Khiri Khan Province
Working groups' reports, and monitoring of the South China Sea situation

te: Online conscript application project followed up
se: The meeting noted the schedule of the study visit to ISOC and the joint meeting with the committee on 21 August 2025. It then invited representatives of the Army Personnel Department, the Territorial Defence Command and the units concerned to give information on the project for men liable for service to apply online to serve as conscripts, including its background, results, problems and the path towards 100% voluntary enlistment
it: Project for applying online to serve as a conscript

te: Results of the forum on security and Thailand's future noted, and a report on drones
se: The meeting noted the plan for preparing the committee's work report (1 April – 30 September 2025), the summary of the academic forum "Security and the Future of Thailand", the study report on the use of attack drones in military operations and terrorism, and the schedule of the committee's study visit to ISOC on 21 August 2025
it: Summary of the academic forum "Security and the Future of Thailand"
Study report: the use of attack drones in military operations and terrorism
Schedule of the committee's study visit to ISOC

te: Report on observing the 2026 security budget, and results of a study of a petition
se: The meeting noted the report on observing the meeting of the Senate ad hoc committee studying the draft Annual Appropriations Act for fiscal year 2026 on security, held on 31 July 2025, and the results of its study of a petition asking for the plan for combining forces and resources for national defence to be made an Emergency Decree, which found that this can be done under the Military Service Act B.E. 2530 (1987). It also noted the progress of the working groups
it: Observing the consideration of the 2026 security budget
Petition asking for the plan for combining forces and resources for national defence to be made an Emergency Decree
Working groups' reports

te: More advisers appointed, and agencies invited on vocational training for discharged soldiers
se: The meeting approved the appointment of 2 additional advisers for submission to the committee, and approved inviting representatives of state and private agencies, such as the personnel and civil affairs departments of the armed services, to give information on promoting and developing skills for conscripts who have been discharged
it: Appointment of additional advisers to the subcommittee
Developing skills for discharged conscripts
